Title: Public preview: Azure Static Web Apps now Supports Node 18

Body.Content:
By using Node 18 for your app, you can leverage the latest language and runtime improvements in Node. For using Node 18 in your Azure functions, please use Functions version 4.x.

Azure Static Web Apps support for Node 18 follows the Node 18 lifecycle. Learn more about Node and other language support in Static Web Apps here.
